home.tagline: I build fast, scalable front-end applications with Angular and React. Also experienced with Java and Spring Boot on the backend.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: A modern, responsive portfolio website showcasing my work and experience. Built with Angular and PrimeNG for a polished, professional interface. Features dynamic content loading, smooth animations, and a fully responsive design that works seamlessly across all devices.

projects.title: RGR E-commerce
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce platform with integrated payment processing. Built with Next.js for optimal performance and SEO, featuring Stripe integration for secure transactions. Includes product catalog, shopping cart, checkout flow, and order management capabilities.

experience.description: Networking hardware manufacturer specializing in fiber platform solutions.
bullets: Led the architecture and development of a new Network Management System (NMS) using Next.js and TypeScript.
Built scalable state and async workflows by integrating Redux Toolkit and Redux-Saga across the NMS platform.
Developed Spring Boot REST APIs to support safe and preserve-reset operations for switch configuration management.
Refactored and enhanced the company's Angular-based NMS, improving modularity, maintainability, and long-term extensibility.
Designed and implemented a D3.js-based visualization engine for real-time virtual circuit metrics and topology layouts.
Collaborated closely with backend and firmware teams to optimize API contracts and improve overall system reliability.
Added a PNG export feature allowing users to download detailed network topology diagrams for documentation and reporting.

experience.description: Global data analytics and consumer intelligence company.
bullets: Developed and maintained enterprise web applications using Angular, Spring Boot, and Hibernate.
Built and documented RESTful APIs leveraging JPA and Hibernate for reliable, efficient data access.
Created custom MicroStrategy dashboards and plugins to extend internal analytics capabilities across the organization.
Integrated Firebase Cloud Messaging to enable mobile push notifications for multiple business products.
Automated UI and regression test suites with Selenium and TestNG, reducing QA turnaround time by over 40%.

about.headline: About Me
about.summary: I’m a front-end developer who loves working with Angular and React/Next.js. I enjoy building clean, fast, and modern interfaces, and I’m always exploring new tools and ideas. Most of my work lives in the front end, but I’ve also worked with backend services in Java, so I understand the full picture of how things fit together.
bullets: Frontend: Angular, Next.js, React, TypeScript, RxJS, Redux Toolkit, Redux-Saga, PrimeNG, Tailwind, PrimeFlex, D3.js
Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Express, Hibernate, JPA, REST APIs, MongoDB, Firebase
DevOps: Docker, GitHub Actions, Render, Vercel
Practices: SOLID, Clean Architecture, CI/CD, Accessibility
about.closing: I’m passionate about aligning design intent with technical implementation to create scalable, user-focused applications through component-driven development, mentoring developers, and optimizing performance across modern frameworks. I’m open to collaborations or full-time roles that prioritize scalable architecture and exceptional developer experience.
